title: Stage 5.4 Temporal Composition Stabilization — Formal Preregistration (TS-0 vs TS-1)

preregistration.timing: All decision gates are selected before Stage 5.4 Formal; no Formal aggregate result exists or may be read during preparation.
preregistration.engineering_diff_conclusion: The four commits change loader canonical-SHA verification, diagnostics schema adaptation, frozen-regression evidence plumbing, and null-center cross-check semantics only. They do not change TS-0, TS-1, EMA, alpha, reset rules, geometry, floor/clamp, fallback, dataset, subject, frame selection, or scientific metric definitions.

research_question: Does fixed alpha=0.5 EMA crop-center stabilization materially reduce frame-to-frame temporal jitter relative to frozen Stage 5.3 CMP-1, while keeping the preregistered spatial-quality regressions within small tolerances?

smoke_evidence.role: DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; supports proceeding to Formal but is not a Formal substitute and is not used to tune alpha or gates repeatedly.

scientific_variables.ts0: Stage 5.3 FINAL FROZEN CMP-1, no smoothing
scientific_variables.ts1: ema_crop_center_v1 over the sanitized primary-subject center, re-placed with frozen Stage 5.3 floor/clamp geometry

reset_rules.NEW_VIDEO: EMA state never crosses video_id boundaries
reset_rules.FRAME_GAP_GT_1: reset when current frozen frame id minus previous frozen frame id is greater than 1
reset_rules.FALLBACK: current fallback emits frozen center crop and clears state; the next non-fallback frame restarts from its own frozen center

confirmatory_dev142.definition: Frozen Dev166 minus all 24 whole video_ids in the SHA-frozen Stage 5.4 Smoke24 manifest
confirmatory_dev142.heldout_overlap_evidence: set-theoretic inheritance from the frozen Dev166 split contract; Heldout is not opened or enumerated
confirmatory_dev142.role: confirmatory development subset; NOT Heldout, NOT official validation, and NOT official test

primary_temporal.normalized_displacement: |cx_t - cx_(t-1)| / W over adjacent non-fallback frozen frame pairs; mean, median, P90, P95, max
primary_temporal.temporal_acceleration: absolute change in consecutive signed crop-center displacements / W over adjacent non-fallback triplets; mean, median, P90, P95, max

decision_rule.application: All gates below are evaluated independently on Full Dev166 and Confirmatory Dev142; both analysis sets must pass. No gate may be changed after Formal begins.

temporal_benefit_gates.p95_displacement: TS-1 relative regression <= 0%; any increase fails
temporal_benefit_gates.large_jump_nonincrease: TS-1 ratio must be <= TS-0 at each of >0.10, >0.20, and >0.30
temporal_benefit_gates.large_jump_material_benefit: At >0.20, relative reduction must be >=25%; if TS-0 is zero, TS-1 must also be zero

rationale: 20% displacement and 30% acceleration reductions represent practically material stabilization rather than numerical noise.
P95 and every preregistered large-jump threshold cannot regress, protecting tail behavior.
The >0.20 jump gate requires a simple 25% relative improvement without using a smoke-decimal boundary.
Spatial tolerances are round absolute percentage-point limits: small losses are allowed only in exchange for material temporal benefit; strong off-center subjects receive an explicit guardrail.
The same gates on Smoke-excluded Dev142 limit development feedback bias.

all_must_pass: crop size unchanged on every frame
fallback placement unchanged on every fallback frame
Stage 5.3 manifest canonical SHA and byte SHA verified
Stage 5.2 policy semantic SHA verified and frozen summary raw semantic SHA matches
protocol and config snapshots included in artifact manifest

limitations: There is no official composition ground truth; spatial visible-fraction and weak-reference evidence cannot establish official competition-score improvement.
The weak spatial reference is diagnostic only and not a promotion gate.
Confirmatory Dev142 is still a development subset, not Heldout.
Multi-subject diagnostics are observation only and cannot authorize a union/fusion policy.
interpretation_boundary: A PASS supports fixed-alpha temporal stabilization on frozen Dev166 under these metrics only.
A FAIL may not be repaired by changing gates, alpha, dataset, or exclusions after Formal.
No claim about official test performance, causal video quality, or generalization to Heldout is permitted.
references: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065
next_step_gate: A separate future Formal Executor may run stage5_4_formal only after this protocol is committed as PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_FORMAL and Windows, AutoDL, and origin/master are at the same execution HEAD.
